sources.title: QuerynAi/queryn-adapter-bge-m3_to_me5-large · Hugging Face
sources.snippet: Queryn adapter — bge-m3 → me5-large Translates an embedding produced by bge-m3 into the embedding space of me5-large, so a corpus already embedded with bge-m3 can be served against a me5-large index without re-embedding it. Part of the Queryn embedding-translation engine.

sources.snippet: Project Abstract Queryn is an embedding translation and enrichment engine: given a text chunk and its existing embedding from Model A, it returns the equivalent embedding in Model B's space — without re-embedding the source corpus. It ships as a local program, invoked directly against a customer's own infrastructure and authenticated with credentials — not a hosted HTTP API. The core ...

sources.snippet: Add any new embedding model to EMBEDDING_MODELS first if needed. Run dataset_splitting.py to produce a fresh data/splits/ {train,test}.parquet. Point a training pipeline (v1_adapter_model_training.py or later) at the new splits and run it — resumability means a crash or Ctrl-C just picks back up from the first unfinished pair.
